news.title: Venier awarded $400,000 MDARD grant to study PFAS in Michigan
news.summary_en: O’Neill professor Marta Venier receives a $400K Michigan grant to study how PFAS enters farm fields and help strengthen agricultural resilience.

news.title: Gahl-Mills, Baggetta look to empower others as co-directors of OLC
news.summary_en: The Paul H. O’Neill Center for Leadership in Public Service co-directors Karen Gahl-Mills and Matthew Baggetta discuss how leadership is learned through practice, coaching, and empowering others.
